gloss: year after year, year by year

definitions.gloss: year after year, year by year
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something changes or continues with each passing year. Often used with verbs describing gradual increase, decrease, or change.

examples.japanese: {年々|ねんねん}⟦{暑|あつ}く→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's getting hotter year after year.

examples.japanese: {年々|ねんねん}⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The population is declining year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年々|ねんねん}⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧になっている。
examples.english: Technology is advancing year by year, making life more convenient.

notes:
{年々|ねんねん} emphasizes gradual change over multiple years.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {年々|ねんねん}〜⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become ~ year after year
- {年々|ねんねん}⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ / ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: to increase/decrease year by year
- {年々|ねんねん}〜て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: continuing to ~ year after year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧: every year (neutral repetition, no implication of change)
- {年々|ねんねん}: year by year (implies progressive change over time)
